traceability.notes: The 010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT story is fully implemented. The codebase introduces and validates the @supports annotation format, integrates it into both shallow format validation and deep requirement validation, and updates the require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation rules to treat @supports as satisfying both story and requirement presence. Mixed usage of @story/@req and @supports is supported and tested, legacy behavior remains intact, and error messages include the story path for missing requirements. Requirement IDs are scoped per story file via a cached per-file requirement set. Multiple test files explicitly reference this story and its requirement IDs, and all such tests pass in the current Jest run. All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are therefore satisfied, so the status is PASSED.
